marketplace.summary: Takes homologous sequences to a defensible phylogeny: alignment and trimming, model selection, maximum-likelihood and Bayesian trees with honest support and convergence checks, coalescent species trees, divergence dating, and publication-ready tree figures.

skills.name: bio-alignment-multiple
skills.description: Choose and run MAFFT, MUSCLE5, Clustal Omega or T-Coffee by dataset size, divergence and downstream use, including codon-aware and confidence-assessed alignments.

skills.name: bio-phylo-modern-tree-inference
skills.description: IQ-TREE and RAxML-NG trees with ModelFinder, UFBoot2 and SH-aLRT support, concordance factors, partitioning, topology tests and long-branch-attraction checks.

skills.name: bio-phylo-bayesian-inference
skills.description: MrBayes posteriors gated on scalar and topology convergence, prior checks, stepping-stone model comparison and site-heterogeneous models for deep data.

skills.name: bio-phylo-species-trees
skills.description: ASTRAL, wASTRAL and ASTRAL-Pro species trees from gene trees, concordance factors, polytomy tests and minority-quartet checks for introgression.

skills.name: bio-alignment-trimming
skills.description: ClipKIT, trimAl and BMGE trimming chosen by downstream goal, with retention rules, column maps and trimmed-versus-untrimmed tree checks.

skills.name: bio-phylo-divergence-dating
skills.description: MCMCTree, BEAST2 and LSD2 dating with fossils as soft minima, prior-only runs and temporal-signal tests before tip-dating.

skills.name: bio-phylo-distance-calculations
skills.description: Model-corrected distance matrices and NJ, BIONJ or FastME trees with saturation checks, LogDet for compositional bias and valid bootstrap support.

skills.name: bio-phylo-tree-manipulation
skills.description: Outgroup, MAD, MinVar and non-reversible rooting with stated uncertainty, distance-preserving pruning and support-based collapsing.

skills.name: bio-phylo-tree-io
skills.description: Read, convert and write Newick, Nexus, phyloXML and NeXML trees without losing posteriors, HPD intervals or support values.

skills.name: bio-phylo-tree-visualization
skills.description: Publication tree figures with named support measures, HPD bars, correct rooting and vector export via Bio.Phylo or ggtree.
